column1: # CADCraft Georgian (ქართული) interface catalog — original translations by the CADCraft contributors.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied.
# Clean room: every entry is written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Georgian computing and technical-drawing (ხაზვა) vocabulary (შრე, ზომა, დაშტრიხვა, მომრგვალება,
# ფასკა, წანაცვლება, მოკვეთა, ობიექტზე მიბმა, ხედვის არე, განლაგება). No other product's Georgian
# interface, string table or terminology database was consulted, and no other catalog is used as a source.
# UTF-8: context<TAB>English source<TAB>Georgian translation.
# Empty context = ordinary label; @plural = one form with {n} (a Georgian noun stays singular after
# a numeral: "5 კომიტი"); menu = a menu heading where it differs from the label.
# Commands are verbal nouns (შენახვა, შემობრუნება); prompts read "მიუთითეთ …" for Specify,
# "შეიყვანეთ …" for Enter and "მონიშნეთ …" for Select. Georgian has no letter case: nothing is
# capitalised and Mtavruli is never used.
# Keep command IDs, keywords (Top, Zero, Bottom, _tan to, nX/nXP, Multiple, PICKADD, QPMODE),
# technology/product names and user data unchanged.
